title: odontarrhena corsica
intro: Odontarrhena corsica, commonly known as Corsican pennyroyal, is a plant species native to the island of Corsica. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, relieve anxiety, and act as a diuretic, making it useful for treating menstrual cramps and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Odontarrhena corsica include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
